'''Dagus Parral''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] and citizen of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] he came to [[Voss]], where in the [[Kri-Ta Outpost]], he asked a Republic individual to free the [[Vorantikus|Vorantiki]] captured by the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] before they could be turned into [[Ssorokk|Cyberbeasts]].<ref name="AAD" />
